name: usage-limit
description: Keeps the account usage limit from running out mid-task, with separate limits for the 5-hour and the 7-day windows: one subagent at a time (90% and 97%), a commit of the work in progress (97% and 98%), a pause that keeps the rest for you (98% and 99%), each one switchable, and an automatic resume when the window resets.

fiveHourThrottle.title: 5-hour throttle
fiveHourThrottle.description: In the 5-hour window, from its throttle percentage, only one subagent runs at a time. Unset is on, or off for the commit when the old commitAt is 0.

fiveHourThrottleAt.title: 5-hour throttle from (%)
fiveHourThrottleAt.description: The 5-hour throttle percentage. Unset is 90, or the old alert when set.

fiveHourCommit.title: 5-hour commit
fiveHourCommit.description: In the 5-hour window, from its commit percentage, the agent is asked once per window to commit its work in progress, without pushing. Unset is on, or off for the commit when the old commitAt is 0.

fiveHourCommitAt.title: 5-hour commit from (%)
fiveHourCommitAt.description: The 5-hour commit percentage. Unset is 97, or the old commitAt when set.

fiveHourPause.title: 5-hour pause
fiveHourPause.description: In the 5-hour window, from its pause percentage, the session stops calling tools and keeps the rest of the window for you. Unset is on, or off for the commit when the old commitAt is 0.

fiveHourPauseAt.title: 5-hour pause from (%)
fiveHourPauseAt.description: The 5-hour pause percentage. Unset is 98, or the old 100 minus reserve when set.

sevenDayThrottle.title: 7-day throttle
sevenDayThrottle.description: In the 7-day window, from its throttle percentage, only one subagent runs at a time. Unset is on, or off for the commit when the old commitAt is 0. Per-model weekly windows follow it.

sevenDayThrottleAt.title: 7-day throttle from (%)
sevenDayThrottleAt.description: The 7-day throttle percentage. Unset is 97, or the old alert when set. Per-model weekly windows follow it.

sevenDayCommit.title: 7-day commit
sevenDayCommit.description: In the 7-day window, from its commit percentage, the agent is asked once per window to commit its work in progress, without pushing. Unset is on, or off for the commit when the old commitAt is 0. Per-model weekly windows follow it.

sevenDayCommitAt.title: 7-day commit from (%)
sevenDayCommitAt.description: The 7-day commit percentage. Unset is 98, or the old commitAt when set. Per-model weekly windows follow it.

sevenDayPause.title: 7-day pause
sevenDayPause.description: In the 7-day window, from its pause percentage, the session stops calling tools and keeps the rest of the window for you. Unset is on, or off for the commit when the old commitAt is 0. Per-model weekly windows follow it.

sevenDayPauseAt.title: 7-day pause from (%)
sevenDayPauseAt.description: The 7-day pause percentage. Unset is 99, or the old 100 minus reserve when set. Per-model weekly windows follow it.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the times shown, such as America/New_York. Empty uses the system time zone.

resume.title: Resume when the window resets
resume.description: Resume the session on its own when the window resets, after the pause or after the limit error. Off, you resume it.

bandFrom.title: Band from (%)
bandFrom.description: Show the usage band above the prompt from this share of the usage limit.

alert.title: Alert (%), old
alert.description: Before 1.2: the throttle percentage of every window. Applies where the window's own option is unset.

commitAt.title: Commit from (%), old
commitAt.description: Before 1.2: the commit percentage of every window, 0 off. Applies where the window's own options are unset.

reserve.title: Reserve (%), old
reserve.description: Before 1.2: every window pauses at 100 minus this value. Applies where the window's own option is unset.
